newsitem.title: UK: Med oil product prices steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Med oil product prices steady in thin trade.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were steady on Thursday in thin trade, with dealers unsure of the market's future direction.
Gas oil held a steady tone, although physical activity fell short of Wednesday's trio of Russian deals.
Traders said Russian gas oil was steady at around high fob quotes +25 cents.
A couple of non-Russian 0.2 percent cargoes were heard being offered with discussion centring around fob high quotes +$3-4.

Diesel material was still being met by lack of interest with prices talked steady at high cif EN590 quotes -50 cents. Sellers were optimistic that agricultural demand would start to kick in, but so far there has been little sign of this.
Gasoline was steady with a dearth of spot cargoes due to spring maintenance work at a number of refineries balanced out by a lack of demand.
"I think people have taken the shutdowns into consideration and covered requirements for at least until the end of the month," one trader said.
"I would expect to see the situation tightening as we move toward the summer and more people take to the road," the trader added.
According to data from trade group Unione Petrolifera, Italian petroleum consumption fell 8.7 percent to 7.7 million tonnes in February against the same month in 1996.

High sulphur fuel oil prices were steady, supported by reports of cargo shipments to the Far East where product prices are healthier. But traders said supply was good and the outlook on balance was still bearish.
The market was also quiet on the low sulphur side, with no change seen in prices. Traders said cheap trans-Atlantic supplies were still available.
